text: In the first scene, I feel like an outsider looking in, observing a group absorbed in some form of lecture or collaboration. The glass wall separates me physically and perhaps intellectually—the line between observer and participant is palpable. In the second image, I am drawn into the vibrancy of the R+D exhibition. Surrounded by bold colors and futuristic themes, I feel curious and excited; innovation hangs in the air. The energy here is more inviting, encouraging me to contemplate the interplay of research and development, and my own role within this evolving narrative.
